title: Coverage of an STC interval after selecting effect modifiers on the same data
question: When effect modifiers are selected on the analyzed data before an STC, does an interval that treats the selected model as fixed keep its coverage, and does resampling the whole procedure restore it?
design: G-computation STC with six candidate modifiers, five selection rules (all, oracle, none, p < 0.2, lasso), naive and whole-procedure bootstrap intervals, three sample sizes and one or three true modifiers. 400 replicates per cell.
